solution_card_names: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
solution_steps: Activate Giant Trunade. All monsters except for Giga Gagagigo and Wingweaver will be destroyed because they require their summoning card to remain on the field.
Then, use Special Hurricane by discarding Breaker the Magical Warrior. Since both monsters on the field were Special summoned, they are destroyed.
Next, Summon Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End by removing Breaker and Wingweaver in your grave from play.
Use Premature Burial to revive Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer.
In Main Phase 2, use Chaos Empereror Dragons effect to solve the puzzle.
